# Jiandong Ding Research Site

This is the personal research site of Jiandong Ding, Principal Algorithm Expert at Huawei Technologies Co. Ltd., Shanghai, China.

The site presents research work across three current directions:

- LLM Agents: AI search, skill retrieval, NL2SQL evaluation, LLM serving systems, and capability governance.
- Recommender Systems: user reactivation, generative recommendation, Semantic-ID interface diagnostics, dynamic retrieval, behavior modeling, and trustworthy prediction.
- Data Mining: weak supervision, robust learning, text mining, analytics, field experiments, and earlier sequence-analysis work.

Primary human-readable pages:

- Home: https://jdding.github.io/
- Full publications: https://jdding.github.io/publications/
- Patents: https://jdding.github.io/patents/

Publication records are grouped by year, with recent work first. Recent updates include an arXiv study on difference-guided text selection for agent skill reranking, an accepted ACM Transactions on Information Systems paper on mitigating popularity bias in recommendation (arXiv version available), a 2026 arXiv study on risk exposure in agent skill retrieval, a 2026 arXiv resource paper on Semantic-ID interface diagnostics, an EMNLP 2026 Industry Track paper on training-free AI search, RecSys 2026 work on zero-observation user reactivation, CIKM 2026 papers on Semantic-ID diagnostics and multi-task recommendation, and a TKDE paper on dynamical heterogeneous graph embedding for cold-start resilient recommendation. Digest pages summarize individual papers and connect them to the site's research directions. Patent records include patent number, status, year, applied area, source link, and inventor role.

For research collaboration, student research internships, invited talks, and general exchange, contact dingjiandong2@huawei.com.
